name: Parcels (county service)
description: Reads the parcel polygon at the point from a county or city open-data service you give the address of (an ArcGIS REST layer; terms differ by county). It asks the service only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; nothing is sent at start-up, no key is used, and the answer is kept 24 hours in this browser.
author: CadCraft
